preconditions.description: The dimensions of the field must be within the specified bounds.
The total number of squares in the field must be at least 2.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the minimum number of teleporters k.
The output must contain k teleporter definitions followed by the path of length n*m + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x1 <= n and 1 <= y1 <= m and 1 <= x2 <= n and 1 <= y2 <= m for x1, y1, x2, y2 in teleporters)
postconditions.description: All teleporter coordinates must be within the bounds of the field.
The path must start and end at the capital (1, 1).
The path must visit every square exactly once, except the capital which is visited twice.
